info.title: SupaKnock API
info.description:
SupaKnock installation API for feedback, chat and administration. The same routes serve the web app, iPhone app and trusted backend integrations. Public feedback reads need no credentials; private data is filtered by the acting account and project. Cookie mutations require CSRF and the installation Origin. Administrator bearer sessions do not require CSRF. Project keys belong only on trusted servers. Customer and visitor chat credentials use X-Chat-Token and never grant administration.

The API contract is the same with SQLite, PostgreSQL and Supabase PostgreSQL. Configure the database on the server; clients never connect to installation tables. See /api-docs for integration examples. WebSocket chat is described separately in x-websockets because OpenAPI paths describe HTTP operations.

Administrator account required (browser session or native bearer token). Use an administrator feedback_session cookie or ns_ bearer session. Participant accounts cannot use this operation. Project credentials cannot create projects, administer accounts, archive resources or manage credentials.

SupaKnock’s optional iPhone push relay is https://relay.supaknock.com. Call this settings endpoint on your own installation, not on the relay. Feedback and chat also use your installation. The server enrolls with the relay and keeps its credential encrypted; clients never receive it.

To enable push, send {"enabled":true,"relay_url":"https://relay.supaknock.com"}. Use the HTTPS origin without /api/v1. Push is off by default. You may choose a compatible self-hosted relay before enrollment; the enrolled origin cannot be changed through this setting.

Cookie-authenticated requests require Origin equal to PUBLIC_BASE_URL and X-CSRF-Token from sign-in. Bearer sessions and project credentials do not use CSRF tokens.

post.summary: A customer, administrator or AI message was committed
post.description: Opt in through project webhook settings. Signed raw JSON using X-Feedback-Timestamp, X-Feedback-Signature and X-Feedback-Event-ID. At least once; delivery ordering is not guaranteed. Customer/admin events retain schema_version 1 and customer identity. AI events use schema_version 2, sender_role ai and no customer identity. Filter sender_role=admin for human replies; AI messages never count as human response time. Bodies and citations remain behind authenticated chat APIs. Deduplicate the stable event ID and use conversation sequence for history. See docs/chat.md and docs/webhooks.md. Verify X-Feedback-Signature as v1= followed by the hexadecimal HMAC-SHA256 of X-Feedback-Timestamp + "." + the exact raw UTF-8 request body, using the webhook signing secret. X-Feedback-Timestamp is Unix seconds. Deduplicate by X-Feedback-Event-ID. Delivery is at least once and ordering is not guaranteed. Any 2xx response acknowledges delivery. Redirects are not followed; network failures, 408, 425, 429 and 5xx retry with bounded backoff (eight attempts including the first). Existing jobs retain their destination, payload and signing-secret snapshot. Manual retry uses that same saved event.

/api/v1/chat/ws.summary: Resume live messages for one authorized conversation
/api/v1/chat/ws.description: Use wss with an HTTPS installation. Obtain a fresh ticket over authenticated HTTP, open the socket without URL query parameters, and send the hello frame within five seconds. Browser credentials require their bound Origin; native customer credentials omit Origin. Authentication comes from the ticket, not cookies or URL credentials. After ready, state describes the current conversation and message frames replay committed messages after your cursor. On reconnect, obtain another ticket and send your highest received sequence. Deduplicate message and ack frames by message ID. Authorization and ownership are rechecked throughout the connection. HTTP remains available for all durable operations. Save optional follow_up_email through HTTP message creation; WebSocket message frames do not save contact details.

closeCodes.4403: Rejected before acceptance: URL query parameters or an invalid Origin.
closeCodes.4401: Credentials expired, were revoked, or no longer authorize this conversation.
closeCodes.4400: Invalid input, frame limit, per-session connection limit or another protocol error.
